zh-CN.headlineFact: 规则、需求与四场灾害定义今天的行动表
zh-CN.headlineView: 经营韧性与救援速度同时接受现实检验
zh-CN.headlineFull: 规则、需求与四场灾害定义今天的行动表；经营韧性与救援速度同时接受现实检验
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟包裹税费、AI透明期限与美国零售回落改变经营判断；加沙会谈、哥伦比和印尼地震、欧洲山火与Lala风暴把风险响应推到今天的中心。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 未来感不是预测得更远，而是把今天的规则、现金流和风险接进同一套仪表盘。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 灯很多，先看哪一盏正在闪红。

en-US.headlineFact: Rules, demand and four disasters define today's action sheet
en-US.headlineView: operating resilience and response speed face a real-world test
en-US.headlineFull: Rules, demand and four disasters define today's action sheet; operating resilience and response speed face a real-world test
en-US.intro: EU parcel duties, AI transparency deadlines and weaker US retail demand shape business decisions, while Gaza talks, earthquakes in Colombia and Indonesia, European wildfires and Lala put risk response at the center.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Futurism is not seeing farther; it is connecting today's rules, cash flow and risks to one dashboard.
en-US.doudouQuote: There are many lights; start with the one flashing red.

sources.title: EU applies EUR3 customs duty per item on low-value e-commerce consignments

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟每件3欧元关税进入税费归集实战
zh-CN.headlineView: 卖家要把SKU件数、VAT与潜在处理费拆开
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟每件3欧元关税进入税费归集实战；卖家要把SKU件数、VAT与潜在处理费拆开
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟7月1日起对150欧元以下进口商品按件征收临时3欧元关税，VAT指南要求明确税务处理；联盟处理费最早可能从11月起实施，定价模型不能只看包裹总价。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 按件计税会让多件低客单订单的毛利结构彻底不同。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 一箱三件不是三欧元，先把件数数清。

en-US.headlineFact: The EU's EUR3 per-item duty has entered real VAT reconciliation
en-US.headlineView: sellers must separate SKU count, VAT and a possible handling fee
en-US.headlineFull: The EU's EUR3 per-item duty has entered real VAT reconciliation; sellers must separate SKU count, VAT and a possible handling fee
en-US.intro: Since July 1, the EU has applied a temporary EUR3 duty per item on imports under EUR150, with guidance clarifying VAT treatment; a Union handling fee could start no earlier than November, so parcel value alone is no longer enough.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Per-item duty changes the margin structure of multi-item low-ticket orders.
en-US.doudouQuote: Three items in one box are not a three-euro problem; count first.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 存量生成式AI的标记改造窗口只到12月2日
zh-CN.headlineView: 产品团队必须把可见提示与机器可读标记排进版本表
zh-CN.headlineFull: 存量生成式AI的标记改造窗口只到12月2日；产品团队必须把可见提示与机器可读标记排进版本表
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟AI法案透明要求已于8月2日进入执行期；在此之前已投放市场的生成式AI系统，可在12月2日前完成内容标记与检测义务改造，窗口正在快速缩短。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 合规不是页脚声明，而是要进入生成、导出和审核链路。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 四个月很长，直到它被拆成三个开发迭代。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: Legacy generative AI has until December 2 to finish marking changes
en-US.headlineView: product teams must schedule visible notices and machine-readable marks
en-US.headlineFull: Legacy generative AI has until December 2 to finish marking changes; product teams must schedule visible notices and machine-readable marks
en-US.intro: EU AI Act transparency rules became enforceable on August 2; generative AI systems already on the market have until December 2 to meet content-marking and detection duties, leaving a rapidly shrinking implementation window.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Compliance is not a footer; it belongs in generation, export and review flows.
en-US.doudouQuote: Four months feels long until it becomes three engineering sprints.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sources.publisher: European Commission AI Act Service Desk

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国7月零售销售环比下降0.6%
zh-CN.headlineView: 一人公司要用真实复购而非活动峰值判断需求
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国7月零售销售环比下降0.6%；一人公司要用真实复购而非活动峰值判断需求
zh-CN.intro: 美国7月零售销售创2025年5月以来最大月度降幅，6月增幅也被修正为0.2%；剔除加油站和汽车经销商后仍下降0.2%，暑期活动红利退潮。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 流量峰值可以制造热闹，复购和回款才说明需求是否留下。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 促销散场后，还回来的人才是真客户。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: US retail sales fell 0.6% in July
en-US.headlineView: solo firms should judge demand by repeat buying, not event peaks
en-US.headlineFull: US retail sales fell 0.6% in July; solo firms should judge demand by repeat buying, not event peaks
en-US.intro: US retail sales posted their largest monthly drop since May 2025, while June's gain was revised to 0.2%; excluding gas stations and auto dealers, sales still fell 0.2% as summer-event spending faded.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Traffic peaks create noise; repeat purchases and cash collection show what demand remains.
en-US.doudouQuote: The real customers are the ones who return after the promotion ends.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美方特使与哈马斯领导人在埃及罕见会面
zh-CN.headlineView: 停火路线图重新推进但解除武装仍是核心障碍
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美方特使与哈马斯领导人在埃及罕见会面；停火路线图重新推进但解除武装仍是核心障碍
zh-CN.intro: 美国特使Jared Kushner在埃及与哈马斯领导人举行罕见会面，并计划与以色列总理会谈；此前停滞的加沙停火进程再次启动，但解除武装仍决定下一阶段能否落地。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 会面打开一扇门，真正的进展要看各方是否愿意交出最难的筹码。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 地图上的路又亮了，路障还没有消失。

en-US.headlineFact: A US envoy held a rare meeting with Hamas' leader in Egypt
en-US.headlineView: the ceasefire road map is moving again, but disarmament remains central
en-US.headlineFull: A US envoy held a rare meeting with Hamas' leader in Egypt; the ceasefire road map is moving again, but disarmament remains central
en-US.intro: US envoy Jared Kushner met the Hamas leader in Egypt and planned talks with Israel's prime minister, restarting movement on the stalled Gaza ceasefire while disarmament remains the key obstacle to the next phase.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A meeting opens a door; progress depends on whether each side will release its hardest bargaining chip.
en-US.doudouQuote: The route is lit again, but the roadblocks are still there.

sources.title: Kushner has a rare meeting with Hamas' leader on the Gaza road map

zh-CN.headlineFact: 哥伦比亚请求美国暂停关税支持震后恢复
zh-CN.headlineView: 灾害救援开始与贸易现金流直接相连
zh-CN.headlineFull: 哥伦比亚请求美国暂停关税支持震后恢复；灾害救援开始与贸易现金流直接相连
zh-CN.intro: 哥伦比亚总统在7.4级地震后请求美国暂时中止关税，以降低重建期的经济压力；灾后需求正从搜救扩展到进口成本、企业现金流与基础设施恢复。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 大灾之后，关税、信贷和物流都会变成救援工具的一部分。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 瓦砾要清，账单也要一起减重。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：哥伦比亚地震。

en-US.headlineFact: Colombia asked the US to suspend tariffs for earthquake recovery
en-US.headlineView: disaster response is now directly linked to trade cash flow
en-US.headlineFull: Colombia asked the US to suspend tariffs for earthquake recovery; disaster response is now directly linked to trade cash flow
en-US.intro: Colombia's president asked the United States to pause tariffs after a magnitude 7.4 earthquake, seeking relief from reconstruction pressure as recovery expands from rescue to import costs, business cash flow and infrastructure.
en-US.xiaziQuote: After a major disaster, tariffs, credit and logistics become part of the response toolkit.
en-US.doudouQuote: Clear the rubble and lighten the bill at the same time.

sources.title: Colombian president asks Trump to suspend tariffs to help earthquake recovery

zh-CN.headlineFact: 弗洛勒斯7.7级地震遇难人数升至53人
zh-CN.headlineView: 滑坡搜救与数千人露宿成为下一阶段重点
zh-CN.headlineFull: 弗洛勒斯7.7级地震遇难人数升至53人；滑坡搜救与数千人露宿成为下一阶段重点
zh-CN.intro: 印尼救援队新增发现6名遇难者，使死亡人数升至53人；地震引发的滑坡覆盖多个地区，数千名居民因担心余震在户外过夜，搜救与安置同步承压。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 主震结束并不代表风险结束，滑坡、余震与临时安置会延长危机。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 地面停下后，救援的时钟才真正开始。

en-US.headlineFact: The Flores magnitude 7.7 earthquake death toll rose to 53
en-US.headlineView: landslide searches and shelter for thousands define the next phase
en-US.headlineFull: The Flores magnitude 7.7 earthquake death toll rose to 53; landslide searches and shelter for thousands define the next phase
en-US.intro: Indonesian rescue teams recovered six more bodies, raising the death toll to 53; quake-triggered landslides affected multiple districts and thousands slept outside in fear of aftershocks, straining both search and shelter operations.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The main shock ending does not end the risk; landslides, aftershocks and temporary shelter extend the crisis.
en-US.doudouQuote: When the ground stops, the rescue clock truly starts.

sources.title: Rescuers in Indonesia recover 6 more bodies in earthquake aftermath

zh-CN.headlineFact: 比利时与希腊大规模山火同时告急
zh-CN.headlineView: 高温干燥让跨境消防与撤离能力同时承压
zh-CN.headlineFull: 比利时与希腊大规模山火同时告急；高温干燥让跨境消防与撤离能力同时承压
zh-CN.intro: 比利时东部自然保护区与雅典附近希腊岛屿的山火持续蔓延，希腊已有2人死亡；比利时投入超过250名应急人员，并获得德国消防力量协助。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 山火跨过行政边界时，协同速度就是最现实的防火线。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 风不看地图，消防队必须看同一张图。

en-US.headlineFact: Large wildfires escalated in Belgium and Greece at the same time
en-US.headlineView: hot dry conditions are testing evacuation and cross-border firefighting
en-US.headlineFull: Large wildfires escalated in Belgium and Greece at the same time; hot dry conditions are testing evacuation and cross-border firefighting
en-US.intro: Fires spread through a nature reserve in eastern Belgium and a Greek island near Athens, where two people died; Belgium deployed more than 250 emergency personnel with support from German firefighters.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When fire crosses administrative lines, coordination speed becomes the most practical firebreak.
en-US.doudouQuote: Wind ignores maps, so crews need to share one.

sources.title: Firefighters battle massive wildfires in Belgium and Greece

zh-CN.headlineFact: Lala减弱为热带风暴但仍带来强风雨浪
zh-CN.headlineView: 危险正在从登陆威胁转向积水、海浪与恢复作业
zh-CN.headlineFull: Lala减弱为热带风暴但仍带来强风雨浪；危险正在从登陆威胁转向积水、海浪与恢复作业
zh-CN.intro: Lala最大持续风速降至65英里每小时并向西北移动，仍将为夏威夷带来额外1至3英寸降雨和危险海浪；运营方需继续管理积水、沿海风险与恢复安全。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 风暴降级只是阶段变化，不是风险清零。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 风小一点了，雨水和海浪还没下班。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：夏威夷风暴。

en-US.headlineFact: Lala weakened to a tropical storm but wind, rain and surf remain
en-US.headlineView: risk is shifting from landfall to flooding, waves and recovery work
en-US.headlineFull: Lala weakened to a tropical storm but wind, rain and surf remain; risk is shifting from landfall to flooding, waves and recovery work
en-US.intro: Lala's maximum sustained winds fell to 65 mph as it moved northwest, while another 1 to 3 inches of rain and dangerous surf remained possible across Hawaii; operators still face flooding, coastal and recovery hazards.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A storm downgrade changes the phase; it does not reset risk to zero.
en-US.doudouQuote: The wind eased, but rain and surf are still on shift.

sources.title: Tropical Storm Lala Intermediate Advisory Number 17A
